title: GENERALIZATION_MATRIX: subsystem x slice N/coverage/success/abstention/silent-failure with counts, worst meaningful slice per subsystem
environment: Linux Ubuntu, Node 20.18.1, pnpm 10.15.1, LINUX-CPU (no Apple Vision, no Mac, no iPhone)
verdictRationale: The matrix itself is complete and honest (GREEN as a deliverable), but what it MEASURES is ORANGE: TARGET has 17/54 silent wrong locks with the worst session at 1/4 correct (3 silent failures); CONTACT has 3/11 estimated markers wrong >132ms with volley at 0/3; BALL fastBlur is 0/6 with 3 wrong-location silent failures; STROKE trades to 5 correct / 12 abstained / 2 confidently-wrong under heuristic-6 (coverage cost of the Wave-F gates now measured); CAPTURE_ENVELOPE and AUTO_DETECT have effectively no measurable generalization data (n=2 clips with unvalidated thresholds; n=0). Slice coverage is thin everywhere: 2-5 independent sources per subsystem.
mission: For each subsystem (TARGET, EVENT, PADDLE, BALL, CONTACT, PHASE, STROKE, CAPTURE ENVELOPE, AUTO DETECT) x each slice available in existing labeled/replayable data, report N, coverage, success, abstention, silent failure, and calibration where applicable; identify the worst meaningful slice per subsystem; group by independent source/session; no percentages without counts.
method: Reused existing harnesses only (no production code changed): re-ran the f16 Linux-proxy replay set at head into wave-g artifacts (eventRecallBench, ownershipBench +/- corrections, ballHardSliceEval, e02 contactGoldReplay wrapper, d3-05 phase measure, strokeHeuristicBench); joined per-row outputs to committed slice metadata (ta-bench cases.json sessionKey/situation, paddle-bench.json + registry.json source/session/camera, harness-internal buckets/groups); reused COMMITTED Mac artifacts for the two Linux-unreplayable stages (TARGET: ta-bench-1787969692752.json shipped D-027 variant; PADDLE detector: paddle-bench-1787968828222.json) with provenance labeled; CAPTURE_ENVELOPE from committed c12 measurements; AUTO_DETECT honestly reported as N=0 replayable. Matrix built by committed script g16-build-matrix.py.

datasetScopeAndGrouping.TARGET: 54 verified dev TA cases across 5 sessions (dvids-marne-2024 17, dvids-warriorgames-2026 15, wm-tournament-2014 11, afn-sasebo-2025-06 7, afn-sigonella-2025 4); grouped by sessionKey and situation tags
datasetScopeAndGrouping.EVENT: 14 non-held-out gold target events across 8 bundles / 6 sources; grouped by bundle -> source/session
datasetScopeAndGrouping.PADDLE_detector: 5 dev bundles (Mac artifact), 91 labeled frames; PADDLE ownership proxy: 39 dual frames across 5 session groups and 6 difficulty buckets (Linux replay)
datasetScopeAndGrouping.BALL: 43 D2-06 hard-slice gold labels across 4 bundles / 3 sources; occlusion buckets + hard-slice types
datasetScopeAndGrouping.CONTACT: 15 gold contact events across 7 bundles / 5 sources; sliced by source, bundle, owner, stroke family
datasetScopeAndGrouping.PHASE: 17 anchored / 18 anchor-free gold events across 7 bundles; segmentation coverage only (per-boundary correctness not scored by this harness)
datasetScopeAndGrouping.STROKE: 18 evaluable of 29 stroke gold labels across 3 session groups; L1 OVERHEAD-vs-SWING
datasetScopeAndGrouping.CAPTURE_ENVELOPE: 2 non-held-out committed clips; thresholds unvalidated (e15/f18 negatives)

holdoutStatement: Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were never read, listed, or analyzed; rows bearing their caseIds inside committed Mac artifacts (paddle-bench results, c12 perClip) were dropped by caseId match before any metric was computed. The fresh-candidate pool was untouched. No locked_test was run.

PHASE.note: coverage only; per-boundary correctness not scored by this harness

STROKE.driftVsF16: heuristic-4 -> heuristic-6: l1Correct 9->5, abstained 8->12, confidentlyWrong 3->2 (Wave-F abstention gates' coverage cost, now measured)

CAPTURE_ENVELOPE.thresholdValidation: FAILED twice (e15, f18) — verdicts are v0.1-provisional hypotheses, not truth

AUTO_DETECT.note: no replayable per-slice measured dataset exists; fixture-level tests only

findings: TARGET never abstains (54/54 locked): every one of its 17 errors is a silent failure. Worst sessions: afn-sigonella-2025 1/4 correct (3 silent), afn-sasebo-2025-06 3/7 correct (4 silent). contested_region situation: 23/36 correct, 13 silent.

CONTACT's worst family is volley (0/3 acceptable, 2 wrong markers >132ms); dvids-sasebo source is 1/3 with 2 wrong markers. The estimator at head is contact-evidence-4.3 and the f16 high-conf violation is gone (highConfViolations: []), but wrong-marker count is 3/11 estimated.
BALL fastBlur is a zero-success slice (0/6, 3 wrong-location) and the 2 abstention violations from e12 persist on afn-sasebo-rally2 (occlusionCycle).

STROKE heuristic-6's honesty gates carry a measured coverage cost vs f16's heuristic-4 (5 vs 9 L1 correct; 12 vs 8 abstained; confidently-wrong 3->2). afn-sasebo-2025-06 is now a zero-coverage session (0 answered / 5).

PADDLE ownership answers nothing on the 'clean' bucket (0 correct / 10 abstained / 10 n) while answering on harder buckets — the incumbent method's evidence gates are inverted relative to human difficulty. On frames WITH pose it is 13/18 correct with 1 abstention.
CAPTURE_ENVELOPE and AUTO_DETECT are generalization blind spots: n=2 clips against unvalidated thresholds, and n=0 replayable items respectively.
Independent-source breadth is the binding constraint everywhere: 2-6 sources per subsystem, and several worst slices have n=3-6 (small-n, flagged in the matrix).
honestyNotes: No production code, migrations, or integrator-owned docs were modified; all new files live under datasets/experiments/wave-g/.
TARGET and PADDLE detector tables are COMMITTED Mac artifacts reused as-is (labeled); they were not and cannot be re-run on this box.
PHASE reports segmentation coverage only — the harness does not score per-boundary correctness, so no success/silent-failure numbers were invented for it.
Calibration numbers cited from c11 are agreement proxies with stated caveats; contact calibration bins have tiny n and are labeled indicative only.
Slice dimensions that exist only as free text (lighting, player count, apparent scale, player identity) were declared NOT AVAILABLE rather than converted into invented categories.

gates.test: pnpm test exit 0 (51 files, 593 passed | 4 skipped at tail package; all workspace packages green)
